☄️ New weekly event in DogCity Lunar Launch: METEOR SHOWER

Rocks everywhere, but twice the stardust along the way. Finish with 60% or more for the event bonus, and the top 3 of the week win a name frame.

Unlocks at level 2 🚀
https://dogcity-lunar-launch.vercel.app/

⚔️ Think you're a better pilot than your friends?

Finish a flight in DogCity Lunar Launch, tap "Challenge a friend" and send the link. They fly the exact same asteroids, orbs and rings. Highest score wins.

https://dogcity-lunar-launch.vercel.app/

🐕 Hold $DOG? Connect Xverse, OKX or Kray to DogCity Lunar Launch.

Your real DOG balance sets your pilot rank, and with a DogCity plot you fly for your district in the weekly district war. Data from @dogdatabtc

https://dogcity-lunar-launch.vercel.app/

🎯 Pilot tip: lock the aim inside the green zone and the power in the gold zone.

Nail both and you launch PERFECT, with a starting shield 🛡️ Then grab orbs in a row: the combo multiplies your points up to 5x.

https://dogcity-lunar-launch.vercel.app/

🌙 The October season is on in DogCity Lunar Launch.

Every completed flight earns season points. 10 tiers of rewards, and tier 10 unlocks an exclusive name frame you can only get this month.

https://dogcity-lunar-launch.vercel.app/

🏆 Weekend run! The weekly leaderboard resets Monday at 00:00 Brasília time (UTC−3).

Only completed flights count. Climb with the Meteor Shower event, or reach level 7 and go for the Mars Colony (up to 1,000 pts).

https://dogcity-lunar-launch.vercel.app/

🔧 From rookie to Mars.

Earn Stardust on every flight, upgrade your rocket in the Workshop and unlock new routes: the Moon, the Asteroid Belt and the Mars Colony.

Last day of the Meteor Shower event ☄️
https://dogcity-lunar-launch.vercel.app/
